submission.justification:
Crystal-K3 has the best simulated resolution (2.9% FWHM at 662 keV) but its intrinsic background (2.0 ± 0.2 counts/kg/day, dominated by internal contamination) is about four times the facility budget of 0.5 counts/kg/day, so it fails the low-background constraint. Crystal-K2 meets the background requirement (0.10) but has the poorest resolution (8.5%). Crystal-K1 is the best candidate that satisfies all constraints: intrinsic background 0.30 ± 0.05 counts/kg/day (within the 0.5 budget) and the second-best resolution, 4.5% FWHM at 662 keV. The simulation found weak thickness dependence across 3-8 cm, so the nominal 5 cm thickness (within the 2-10 cm allowed range) is recommended. Caveats: the resolution figure comes from a 2025 simulation at 5 cm only, with no thickness-specific simulation available for this report, and the background is from a 30-day sample count, not the final crystal.</justification>
